name: AI Structure Decorator
description: Uses Gemini to suggest and place decorative Geometry Dash objects around a selected structure.

gemini-api-key.name: Gemini API key
gemini-api-key.description: Stored in this device's Geode settings. Do not share it.

decoration-prompt.name: Decoration style
decoration-prompt.description: Describe the decoration style you want around the selected structure.
decoration-prompt.default: Create clean Geometry Dash 2D decoration with outlines, small details and balanced symmetry. Do not cover the structure.

max-objects.name: Maximum objects
max-objects.description: Maximum number of decorative objects created per request (1-40).
